author: ahdat
text:
Hey bud, just remember, the market doesn't make it easy to figure out
what its doing. There are so many factors when you look at a chart,
between all the different TFs, that you have to look at the whole
picture to get a better sense of what price is trying to do. In this
sense, the difficulty presents an opportunity for you, a barrier of
entry that pays for your winning trades. You really do need months, or
possibility years of screen time to get a 'feel' for it all. Using
Forex Trader will expedite that process.

Now without seeing the HTFs, and looking at just the 5m AUDCAD chart, to
 me it looks like price is weakening, rather than an opportunity for
entry. There are a number of things going against the trade, but the
big ones I see is the engulf you used as an entry wasn't particularly
important, and you see price is moving to LLs and LHs. It looks like
you also TT this one, which inherently will give you lower winning
percentages, but higher RR.

Hope that helps.
